structured.answer: I didn't decide. The page itself picks an account at Pesagot (פסגות) and the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", marked "הזול", and says 70,000 ₪ put in becomes 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. But I don't understand "בכסף של היום", I don't know this site, and I'll ask my son before I do anything.

stuck.why: To me מדד is the price index on the news, so I wasn't sure the page was about saving at all
70,000 with 7% for 10 years should be about 70% more by my reckoning, so 86,492 looked too small and I didn't understand 'בכסף של היום'
The red minus scared me and I didn't understand 'לעומת הבחירה שלכם'
A long column of red minuses and English lines (iShares, Vanguard, UCITS). I got anxious and stopped
